The SaaSNova Story

Why execution, not advice, is the only thing that produces pipeline.

SaaSNova was founded to bridge the gap between passive listing software and high-level consultancies. We embed directly with B2B SaaS teams as boots-on-the-ground operators across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

How It Started

Hyperscaler Roots

After years embedded in cloud ecosystems, building marketplace programs on AWS, managing ISV Accelerate motions, and developing the field relationships that drive momentum on Azure and GCP, Jen founded SaaSNova to fill a gap no platform or consultancy was filling: operator-led execution.

What We Do

The Embedded Operating Model

Platforms give ISVs listing infrastructure. Consultancies give ISVs frameworks. Neither drives field enablement, activates partner programs, or unlocks marketplace momentum. SaaSNova does all of it, directly, as an embedded operator with clear deliverables in every program period.

How We Are Now

Global Operating Bench & 100+ ISVs

Today, SaaSNova operates as a global bench of practitioners across the US, LATAM, MEA, and APAC. We embed directly with B2B SaaS teams to activate field relationships, drive marketplace momentum, and deliver board-ready pipeline evidence for 100+ enterprise software companies across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
